lines.en: Good evening. I have a reservation.
Welcome to our hotel. When did you make it?
lines.ko: 저희 호텔에 오신 것을 환영해요. 언제 예약하셨어요?

lines.en: I made the reservation last week by phone.
Yes, I see it. How long will you stay?
Two nights. Is the room quiet?
Yes. It's a quiet room on a high floor.
lines.ko: 네. 높은 층에 있는 조용한 방이에요.

lines.en: Where is the elevator?
Right in front of the reception. Here is your key.
lines.ko: 접수처 바로 앞에 있어요. 여기 열쇠요.

lines.en: Thank you. Is breakfast service free?
Yes. Breakfast will start at seven. Enjoy your stay.
lines.ko: 네. 아침 식사는 일곱 시에 시작할 거예요. 즐겁게 머무세요.

lines.en: Hello. This is room twenty.
Yes, Ma'am. How can I help you?
Please bring two more blankets.
Of course. Do you need more help?
Yes. The elevator was slow this morning. Is it okay?
lines.ko: 네. 오늘 아침에 엘리베이터가 느렸어요. 괜찮은 거예요?

lines.en: I'm sorry. We will fix it today.
Thank you. Also, the room is a little cold.
I will send a worker to your floor now.
Great. Your hotel service is very kind.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 이 호텔 서비스는 정말 친절해요.

lines.en: Thank you. Call the reception if you need help.
lines.ko: 고마워요. 도움이 필요하시면 접수처로 전화 주세요.
